# Runtime Story Checklist: Coherent Runtime Execution Story

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, and coverage of the runtime-story requirements across frame consistency, evidence truthfulness, cross-view coherence, and workload neutrality
**Created**: 2026-06-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the required runtime-frame identity fields fully specified for every surface handoff, including run identity, branch/path identity, sequence cutoff, time reference, and explanation version? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Does the spec define how run-level phase and status should be determined when explicit workflow-root, goal, or phase evidence is absent? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Are the minimum required fields for each explained activity specified consistently enough that summary, graph, timeline, and inspector can all represent the same activity without inventing details? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec define what metadata must be available for a relationship to be considered evidence-backed rather than merely time-adjacent? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK005 Are the requirements explicit about what remains accessible through progressive disclosure when a story is sparse, uncertain, or incomplete? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-025]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "coherent execution story" broken down into measurable or at least objectively reviewable qualities rather than left as a general aspiration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK007 Is "major phases" defined clearly enough that reviewers can tell whether the feature requires explicit phase evidence, derived grouping, or both? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK008 Is the phrase "important activities" clarified with selection criteria so implementers do not choose significance heuristics inconsistently? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK009 Is "same runtime frame" precise enough to prevent alternative interpretations between current, historical, and branched run views? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-018, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Are "missing", "inconsistent", and "deliberately hidden" evidence conditions defined clearly enough to avoid UI copy or behavior overlap? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Spec §User Story 3]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do the frame-consistency requirements align between the user stories, functional requirements, and success criteria without shifting between sequence-based and timestamp-based framing? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-001, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK012 Are the requirements for overall run outcome consistent with the retry requirements so a failed attempt cannot accidentally dominate a later successful run state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-008, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK013 Do the workload-neutral core concepts listed in the functional requirements stay consistent with the scope boundaries and out-of-scope statements about BSOps-specific behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK014 Are the progressive-disclosure requirements consistent with the evidence-sovereignty constraint so explanation views never outrank permitted recorded evidence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-025, Constitution §II]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 Can reviewers objectively determine whether summary, graph, timeline, and inspector "agree" for the same frame, or do the requirements need a clearer assertion set for what must match? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK016 Are the comprehension success criteria specific enough about operator tasks, allowed aids, and timing conditions to avoid ambiguous evaluation results? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK017 Is the comparative-usability target defined well enough to know which baseline workflow, question set, and run corpus must be used for the 40% improvement claim? [Clarity, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for both first-open comprehension and deep debugging flows, or is one of those scenario classes left underspecified? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK019 Are view-switching requirements complete for all supported entry points, including selecting from summary, graph, timeline, and inspector in either direction? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK020 Does the spec address both live-run and completed-run storytelling requirements with equal clarity, especially when a selected frame is not the latest state? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK021 Are domain-decoration requirements complete for both cases where decoration is available and where it is entirely absent? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023, Spec §User Story 4]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Does the spec define how the story should remain understandable when no activities can be confidently related to one another? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK023 Are late, out-of-order, or conflicting lifecycle events covered with enough specificity to judge whether the requirements prefer omission, downgrade, or explicit contradiction disclosure? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements specified for cases where an activity is representable in one surface but not naturally representable in another? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK025 Does the spec define expected requirement behavior for empty, absent, redacted, encrypted, or oversized inputs/outputs/errors beyond saying they must not be fabricated? [Completeness, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-017]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK026 Are interactive-performance requirements sufficiently quantified for frame changes, cross-view focus changes, and large complex runs, or is "interactive" still too qualitative? [Gap, Non-Functional, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK027 Are accessibility requirements for understanding and navigating the execution story specified anywhere, or are they currently missing from the feature definition? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [x] CHK028 Are permission and redaction requirements detailed enough to define how evidence previews, drill-down paths, and hidden fields should behave across every surface? [Completeness, Non-Functional, Spec §FR-017, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK029 Does the feature define observability or auditability requirements for proving that an explained fact still traces back to specific evidence after future contract evolution? [Coverage, Non-Functional, Spec §FR-015, Constitution §IV]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK030 Are the assumptions about existing telemetry quality and selected-frame identity validated with explicit requirement fallbacks when those assumptions do not hold? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK031 Does the spec document which existing Run UI surfaces are authoritative inputs versus consumers of the unified execution story? [Dependency, Spec §In scope, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK032 Are the required validation fixtures documented precisely enough to know what qualifies as the representative BSOps run and the two non-BSOps comparison runs? [Completeness, Spec §SC-006, Constitution §V]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK033 Is there any unresolved conflict between "concise ordered execution story" and the requirement to preserve access to retries, concurrency, convergence, and evidence gaps without oversimplification? [Conflict, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK034 Does the spec clearly separate core deterministic explanation from optional AI or domain decoration, or could future readers misread enhancement paths as part of the required core experience? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-023, Constitution §III]
- [x] CHK035 Are the requirements clear about whether "phase" is a first-class runtime fact, an optional presentation grouping, or a derived summary concept when evidence is sparse? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Edge Cases]

- [x] CHK036 Are contract-evolution requirements explicit about versioning, compatibility impact, migration, downgrade disclosure, and mixed-client validation? [Critical Gate, Spec §FR-034, Constitution §IV]
